about_the_game:
A wandering wizard arrives on a forgotten island in search of a new form of magic.
What he finds instead are pirates, mercenaries, and a mysterious cult bending that power toward their own dark ambitions.

In Aghaz, you play as Uldaam, a lone mage exploring a hostile island filled with ancient ruins, dangerous enemies, and secrets best left buried. As you uncover the truth behind this volatile magic, you must decide: destroy it and let it be forgotten, or wield it yourself and risk the consequences.

Key Features:

A Risk-Reward Spellcasting System

Magic in Aghaz is powerful but unstable. Every spell generates Heat, and managing it is the key to victory. Carefully balance when to cast safely and when to push beyond your limits to unleash a devastating inferno. The more Heat you build, the stronger your spells become but let it spiral out of control and you’ll suffer being Overheated, leaving you unable to cast at the worst possible moment. Mastering this system rewards skillful play, timing, and a willingness to take risks.

Shape Your Own Wizard

Choose from 10+ spell augments to drastically alter how your magic behaves.
Discover and unlock spell augments throughout your journey, each designed to offer new strategic options rather than simple upgrades. Whether you’re managing Heat more efficiently, countering environmental threats, or enhancing spells with elemental effects like frost and poison, augments let you tailor your magic to the challenges ahead.

Explore a Dangerous Island

The island is a place of forgotten knowledge and constant danger. Venture through ancient dungeons, hidden caves, and crumbling ruins, each filled with environmental hazards, enemies, and secrets. Exploration is rewarded and keen-eyed players will uncover shortcuts, hidden chambers, and powerful augments. The world invites curiosity, but rarely offers safety.

Environmental Puzzles & Hidden Secrets

Progress is not only about combat. Use magic and observation to solve environmental puzzles, manipulate ancient mechanisms, and unlock sealed paths. Many of the island’s most valuable rewards such as lore fragments, augments, and secret areas are hidden off the beaten path, waiting for those willing to explore and experiment.

Lore-Driven Adventure

Discover the story of the island, its inhabitants, and the cult’s true intentions through exploration, secrets, and environmental storytelling.

Action-Focused Combat

Combat blends fast-paced movement with tactical spellcasting. Face pirates, mercenaries, and cultists, each with unique behaviors and threats. Victory depends on positioning, spell timing, and Heat management not just raw power. Experiment with different augments and tactics to overcome increasingly dangerous encounters.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Step into the boots of a wandering wizard as his search for new magics leads him to a mysterious island.  Unleash the fury of your fire magic as you explore the secrets of the island and uncover a plot that could endanger the entire world.
